description: Implementation-tracking catalog for the four-aspect slice (asset file, sidecar, thumbnail/derived, DB asset row): maps operation ids OP-1..OP-12 to their implementing functions, events, aspect reads/writes, guards, nodes and status. Out of catalog scope by design: the read-model invalidation advance (mark_tree_dirty_background in backend/src/tasks/queue/writer.rs) and the dir-album sweep lane (handle_sweep_dir_albums) are not anchored here; tree-epoch modeling is deferred (node N5 / the full aspect boundary).

operations.name: SCAN_INDEX_APPLY
guards: process_file try-and-abort (path_epoch::superseded over baseline/current generation and is_busy)
operations.notes: process_file: Open -> Hash -> Dedup -> Index -> Video; per-path try-and-abort cancels stale scans. Watcher sidecar-only events are dropped by the media gate (N7); scan/backfill is the current repair path.

operations.name: API_UPLOAD
operations.notes: post_upload::upload stores the file (atomic tmp->rename) and fire-and-forget enqueues via submit_uploaded_path -> submit_watcher_index (post_upload.rs:286-294, 534-538); db_row/thumbnail are OP-1's writes after background indexing. Premature-ack hazard tracked as N8 (unindexed window), not a barrier bug.

operations.name: API_DELETE
operations.notes: delete::process_deletes plus cleanup_album_descendants; exact-path thumbnail reap.

operations.name: API_ASSIGN_ASSET
operations.notes: move_asset_into_album: N2 guarded by path lease + resolve-then-validate; N5 cross-table split remains open (ASSET_BY_ID and ASSET_BY_PATH written in separate txns), so the operation status is open.

operations.name: API_ASSIGN_DIR
guards: paired rename via notify tracker cookie (handle_paired_rename)
operations.notes: move_album_into_album plus apply_dir_move_plans: N3 guarded by paired rename + fallback + single-txn rewrite; N5 cross-table split remains open for the per-asset move path, so the operation status is open.

operations.name: API_ROTATE_IMAGE
operations.notes: rotate_image: N11 is refuted (the pre-fix thumbnail-before-sidecar order no longer exists); aspectsRotateTest pins the sidecar-first order. Lease coverage is modeled by aspectsRotateVsScanTest.

operations.name: API_EDIT_METADATA
operations.notes: commit_metadata_edits: write sidecar then store; best-effort rollback.

operations.name: ALBUM_STATS_CASCADE
guards: album_task computes stats outside the txn from a ref_data per-entry snapshot
write-txn album liveness re-check with re-mark pending on race
member writes re-mark pending via mark_album_for_update
operations.notes: album_task: album stats cascade; bounded staleness, no lost update.

operations.name: SWEEP_STALE_PATHS
guards: sweep_remove_batch exact-path resolution with path.exists skip
operations.notes: sweep_stale_asset_paths plus sweep_remove_batch; missing paths only.

operations.name: THUMBNAIL_GENERATE
guards: generate_thumbnail_for_image writes via temp sibling and atomic rename
operations.notes: generate_thumbnail_for_image: derived corruption undetected; regen frame can orphan.

operations.name: RESET_CLEAR_TABLES
operations.notes: clear_asset_tables_and_caches: drops tables and caches; derived bytes orphaned.

operations.name: WATCHER_REMOVE
guards: handle_removed_file restores the exact path for sweep_remove_batch resolution
operations.notes: handle_removed_file plus prune_asset_path: clear path, remove record/thumbnail if last path. prune_asset_path removes the media file and sidecar; handle_removed_file is the FS_DELETE lane, distinct from sweep OP-9.
